name: Scholarship for Ph.D. Students of Socially and Educationally Backward Classes
benefit: **Scholarship Assistance:** - ₹25,000/- for students pursuing M.Phil. - ₹1,00,000/- for students preparing Ph.D thesis.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should belong to the Socially and Educationally Backward Classes (SEBC). 1. The applicant should be pursuing M.Phil or Ph.D at a recognized institution. 1. The applicant’s annual family income should not exceed ₹6,00,000/-.
